messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated TPM and 5xx rate for model polaris7b in us-west-2. Paging eng-sre.
oncall-bot: Severity: P2. Affected customers: 12. Error spike started ~1767777600

samir: reading metrics... seeing tail latency jump and throttles. Is this customer-driven load or bot traffic?

jess: checking request patterns — lots of short chat completions with high concurrency from a single tenant ID. Also seeing funcall errors.

maya: assigning to me for immediate rate shaping. I'll carve 40% capacity from polaris7b to free headroom.

samir: good. Before we change, can we fallback to polaris7b-quant2 variant to reduce GPU memory? That might reduce throttles.

taylor: quant2 not compatible with tool-calls; customers using funcall will get degraded behavior. prefer shaping + per-tenant limit.

carlos: support pinging top 3 affected customers, prepping an email template. No major outages reported yet.

maya: executing mitigation: /infra/traffic-tool set-rate polaris7b --region us-west-2 --tpm 200 --rpm 20 --note "emergency sculpt 40%" 

samir: saw API: rate change applied across nodes. Token/sec dropped ~35% in next 60s.

jess: also disabling funcall routing to polaris7b to avoid errors: /infra/feature-flags disable polaris7b-funcall us-west-2

samir: monitoring. 5xx count trending down. Latency improving.

carlos: customer A confirms reduction in errors, but noticing slower completions. Template sent.

maya: propose to keep sculpt for 45 minutes, then incrementally relax if stable. Anyone object?

taylor: +1. Also create a canary to route 5% back to polaris7b every 10m to verify.

samir: logging actions in incident ticket INC-2026-112. Add rollout notes.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: maya to samir for long-term followup in 30m. Paging cleared to oncall channel.

maya: handing off — will leave the sculpting action in place until samir confirms stable.

samir: I'll take it. Next steps: correlate tenant traffic, block noisy IPs if needed, plan quota raise for dedicated customers.

carlos: followup with customers: offering temporary quota bump on dedicated plan if they need sustained throughput.

jess: keeping an alert for funcall errors to re-enable once backend backlog clears. 

samir: last check: 5xx down 78% from peak, latency 20% improvement. keeping these mitigations until 1767777890.
